contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #311: The Hovey–Strickland and Chai conjectures.
Audit def:coordinates for every prime p, every 1 <= h < n, every small C-valued height-h point x, and every Z_p-basis of the etale Tate lattice.

definitions.C: Algebraically closed complete nonarchimedean characteristic-p field with fixed embedding of F_(p^n).
definitions.R_0: F_(p^n)[[u_1,...,u_(n-1)]], universal marked height-n deformation base in characteristic p.
definitions.stratum: u_1=...=u_(h-1)=0; all parameter norms <1; u_h(x) nonzero.
definitions.G: Algebraic p-divisible group obtained by Weierstrass preparation of the finite kernels of H.
definitions.Theta_y: Specialization from the Honda universal cover; analytic in y for each fixed input; Theta_y(pw)=[p]_(H_y)(Theta_y(w)).
definitions.z_i: Any Z_p-basis of T_x=ker Theta_x, identified with T_p(G_x^et).
definitions.t_i: Theta_x(p^(-1)z_i), with etale images forming an F_p-basis of G_x^et[p].
definitions.M_ij: partial P_y(T)/partial u_(h+j-1), evaluated at (x,t_i), where P_y=[p]_(H_y)=f_y(T^q).

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 311 (The Hovey–Strickland and Chai conjectures.; papers: Stabilizer orbits and thick tensor ideals of dualizable K(n)-local spectra; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
For all objects in CTX_TATE9000311, D(theta)_x equals M and det(M) is nonzero, without assuming infinite compatible lifts of torsion sections.
Uniform Tate-algebra convergence permits differentiating P_y(Theta_y(p^(-1)z_i))=Theta_y(z_i); P_x prime(T)=0 gives D(theta)_x=M with the stated indices and sign.

Over a square-zero local Artin algebra C direct-sum J with perfect residue field C, a p-divisible deformation with a split special-fiber etale quotient splits that quotient if a basis of its etale p-torsion lifts to p-torsion points. The resulting section has the given special-fiber marking.
A marked first-order deformation of a height-h one-dimensional formal group over C whose p-series factors through T^(p^h) is the constant marked deformation.

The full parameter Kodaira-Spencer map R_0^(n-1) -> Hom(omega_(G dual),Lie G) is an isomorphism, and arbitrary-map equivariance identifies its specialization at x with analytic parameter deformations over C[epsilon]/epsilon^2.

Weierstrass-prepared finite kernels define a height-n algebraic p-divisible group over R_0; at x its connected height is h, its etale height is r, and Taylor evaluation of P_y(t_i)=0 is equivalent to membership in its prepared p-torsion level.

For arbitrary fields and finite dimensions, injectivity of a full comparison into connected and etale components, together with vanishing of the connected component on a subspace, implies injectivity and nonzero determinant of the square etale restriction; no rank assumption on that restriction is used.

Manuscript orb:density: for every 1<=h<n and every small height-h point x, an analytic germ on the height-at-least-h parameter polydisc that vanishes on a sufficiently close open-stabilizer orbit is zero.
Manuscript fin:primes: proper primes of E_0 invariant under an open subgroup of the Morava stabilizer are exactly 0,I_1,...,I_n.
Manuscript thm:main: for every prime and height n, the thick tensor ideals of dualizable K(n)-local spectra form the n+2-member strict chromatic chain D_0,...,D_(n+1).
The contraction-limit specialization is analytic, identifies the Honda cover with the inverse limit under [p], and identifies T_x/pT_x with G_x^et[p](C).

Manuscript fin:support gives the all-prime tensor support comparison, including X in the thick tensor ideal of Y if and only if S(X) is contained in S(Y). This external-input assembly is not audited in this mission.
The manuscript curve-detection and translation lemmas and fin:charzero give the remaining analytic inputs to fin:primes; these obligations are not audited in this mission.

Manuscript formal:closure: any nonzero residue-field formal equation on a subgroup of a Honda-group product implies a common nonzero endomorphism annihilator; its Frobenius-separation quantifiers remain to be audited.

Manuscript bundles:nondegeneracy: a nonzero natural Honda-cover morphism gives an endomorphism orbit on independent vectors with no nonzero residue-field formal equation; this is not audited in this mission.
The manuscript integral comparison, stabilizer compatibility, and finite analytic jet results give the remaining inputs to orb:density; these are not audited in this mission.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace TateJacobian

theorem frobenius_ignores_square_zero
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p]
    (a b : R) (hb : b ^ 2 = 0) :
    (a + b) ^ p = a ^ p := by
  have hp : 2 ≤ p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le
  have hz : b ^ p = 0 := by
    calc
      b ^ p = b ^ (2 + (p - 2)) := by congr 1; omega
      _ = b ^ 2 * b ^ (p - 2) := pow_add b 2 (p - 2)
      _ = 0 := by rw [hb, zero_mul]
  rw [add_pow_char a b p, hz, add_zero]

theorem linearized_inseparable_polynomial
    {R I : Type*} [CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p]
    (S : Finset I) (a b : I → R) (k : I → ℕ)
    (e t s : R) (he : e ^ 2 = 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, (a i + e * b i) * (t + e * s) ^ (p * k i)) =
      (∑ i ∈ S, a i * t ^ (p * k i)) +
        e * (∑ i ∈ S, b i * t ^ (p * k i)) := by
  have hes : (e * s) ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [mul_pow, he, zero_mul]
  have hf : (t + e * s) ^ p = t ^ p :=
    frobenius_ignores_square_zero p t (e * s) hes
  have hk (i : I) : (t + e * s) ^ (p * k i) = t ^ (p * k i) := by
    simp only [pow_mul, hf]
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ S, (a i + e * b i) * (t + e * s) ^ (p * k i)) =
        ∑ i ∈ S, (a i * t ^ (p * k i) + e * (b i * t ^ (p * k i))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hk i]
      ring
    _ = (∑ i ∈ S, a i * t ^ (p * k i)) +
        e * (∑ i ∈ S, b i * t ^ (p * k i)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]

theorem section_of_kernel_annihilation
    {E₁ E₂ G : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E₁] [AddCommGroup E₂] [AddCommGroup G]
    (P : E₁ →+ E₂) (pi : G →+ E₂) (W : E₁ →+ G)
    (hP : Function.Surjective P) (hker : P.ker ≤ W.ker)
    (hquot : pi.comp W = P) :
    ∃! s : E₂ →+ G, s.comp P = W ∧ pi.comp s = AddMonoidHom.id E₂ := by
  classical
  let s : E₂ →+ G := P.liftOfSurjective hP ⟨W, hker⟩
  have hs : s.comp P = W :=
    AddMonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp P (Function.surjInv hP)
      (Function.rightInverse_surjInv hP) ⟨W, hker⟩
  have hpi : pi.comp s = AddMonoidHom.id E₂ := by
    ext x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hP x
    have hsy : s (P y) = W y :=
      congrArg (fun f : E₁ →+ G => f y) hs
    have hqy : pi (W y) = P y :=
      congrArg (fun f : E₁ →+ E₂ => f y) hquot
    change pi (s (P y)) = P y
    rw [hsy, hqy]
  refine ⟨s, ⟨hs, hpi⟩, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hP x
  change t (P y) = s (P y)
  exact (congrArg (fun f : E₁ →+ G => f y) ht.1).trans
    (congrArg (fun f : E₁ →+ G => f y) hs).symm

theorem etale_block_det_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (a r : ℕ)
    (L : ((Fin a → K) × (Fin r → K)) →ₗ[K]
      ((Fin a → K) × (Fin r → K)))
    (hL : Function.Injective L)
    (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K)
    (hconnected : ∀ v, (L (0, v)).1 = 0)
    (hetale : ∀ v, (L (0, v)).2 = M.mulVec v) :
    M.det ≠ 0 := by
  have hM : Function.Injective M.mulVec := by
    intro v w h
    have hpair : L (0, v) = L (0, w) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · rw [hconnected v, hconnected w]
      · rw [hetale v, hetale w]
        exact h
    exact congrArg Prod.snd (hL hpair)
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp hM)).ne_zero

theorem det_ne_zero_from_trivial_deformation
    {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (a r : ℕ)
    (KS : ((Fin a → K) × (Fin r → K)) →ₗ[K] V)
    (hKS : Function.Injective KS)
    (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K)
    (htrivial : ∀ v, M.mulVec v = 0 → KS (0, v) = 0) :
    M.det ≠ 0 := by
  have hker : ∀ v, M.mulVec v = 0 → v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hzero : KS (0, v) = KS (0, 0) := by
      simpa only [map_zero] using htrivial v hv
    exact congrArg Prod.snd (hKS hzero)
  have hM : Function.Injective M.mulVec := by
    intro v w h
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply hker
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, h, sub_self]
  exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp hM)).ne_zero

#print axioms frobenius_ignores_square_zero
#print axioms linearized_inseparable_polynomial
#print axioms section_of_kernel_annihilation
#print axioms etale_block_det_ne_zero
#print axioms det_ne_zero_from_trivial_deformation

end TateJacobian

routes.retired_because: A generic matrix theorem conditioned on the etale Jacobian already having full rank, or any finite matrix search, does not prove rank from the actual deformation hypotheses and cannot settle the universal quantifiers.
